description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class LDAPDao for interacting with LDAP authentication and user data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving users, employees, and LDAP synchronization status, specifically handling LDAP-related entities.

classes.name: LDAPDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing LDAP-related database operations, including user retrieval, synchronization status, and employee lookups within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersWhoHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Retrieves employee numbers that are associated with multiple non-deleted user accounts, specifically those with two or more user profiles.

methods.name: getNonLocalUserByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a User entity corresponding to a given username that is not a local password account and is active.

methods.name: getUserByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity for the provided username, if the user exists and is active.

methods.name: getAuthProviderByUserUniqueId
methods.description: Fetches a UserAuthProvider for a user identified by a LDAP-specific unique identifier, ensuring the provider type is LDAP.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Searches for an Employee entity based on various optional search parameters such as employee number, ID, emails, or license numbers.

methods.name: getAllLDAPAuthProviders
methods.description: Retrieves all LDAP authentication providers associated with active users, returning their associated LDAP user DNs and IDs.

methods.name: saveLdapSyncStatus
methods.description: Persists LDAP synchronization status information into the database.

methods.name: getLastLDAPSyncStatus
methods.description: Fetches the most recent LDAP sync status record from the database.
